BICFI.name: BICFI
BICFI.definition: Identification of the financial institution expressed as a BIC.

ClearingSystemMemberIdentification.name: Clearing System Member Identification
ClearingSystemMemberIdentification.definition: Information used to identify a member within a clearing system.

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Name and address of the party.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for the party.

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier, as assigned to a financial institution using a proprietary identification scheme.

BranchIdentification.name: Branch Identification
BranchIdentification.definition: Identification of a specific branch of the financial institution.
